thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 01/17/2019: PLXS, TSM, GOOG, GOOGL, MSFT, IBM, CSCO, AAPL

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 01/17/2019: PLXS, TSM, GOOG, GOOGL, MSFT, IBM, CSCO, AAPL
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.28%
AAPL: -0.57%
IBM: -0.84%
CSCO: -0.27%
GOOG: -0.17%
Technology stocks were retreating pre-market Thursday.
Stocks moving on news include:
(-) Plexus ( PLXS ), which was down more than 5% after i t report ed financial results for fiscal Q1, with better-than-expected earnings and revenue that fell short of analysts' estimates; it also provided guidance for fiscal Q2 in line with Street forecasts.
In other sector news:
(-) Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing ( TSM ) was 2% lower as it reported Q4 adjusted earnings of TWD3.86 per share, or $0.63 per ADS, up from TWD3.83 in the same period a year ago and topping the estimate of TWD3.82 from analysts polled by CapIQ.
(-) Alphabets (GOOG, GOOGL) was slightly lower after Google announced that it is raising the prices of the basic and business editions of its G Suite set of productivity and collaboration tools for the first time.
